naturalness_of_monitorizacion.verdict: reads naturally in the count, empty, read-error, parked, armed and truncated sentences; grammatical but heavy in the two button labels; the one place the abstract noun strains is empty.body ('las monitorizaciones vigilan una cosa'), recorded as NIT ES-SCH-8.
naturalness_of_monitorizacion.not_reopened: the glossary decision itself was not re-opened; the audit checked what the noun breaks downstream (gender cascade, count renders, widths).

findings.detail: The new status word and the untouched clause now share the verb phrase 'ya no está' eight words apart. Round-1 ES-SCH-4 offered 'ya no existe' for the second clause; only the status word landed.

findings.detail: Register only: an activity noun made the plural subject of a concrete verb with a distributive 'una cosa'. The distributive singular is how Spanish phrases the class.
